requirements: Is there exactly one single full-body painting of Aunt Ellie?
Is Aunt Ellie standing alone and centered, filling about 85 percent of the picture height?
Is the pose a three-quarter angle facing toward the left with head tipped slightly forward?
Are the eyes looking toward the left as if listening to someone off-screen?
Are both hands loosely clasped in front at the waist?
Is the mouth a small attentive smile?
Does the facial expression look interested and warm?
Is the head size and body proportion matching the approved Aunt Ellie?
Are the hair, build, age, clothes and colors exactly matching the approved Aunt Ellie?
